independence_note: Dataset card and PhreshPhish paper belong to one source family; TESSERACT and scikit-learn provide independent methodological corroboration. Local artifacts are separate empirical evidence.

sources.decision_support: Entities and similar pages can leak across splits; temporal separation alone is insufficient. Paper v1 methodology is guidance, not proof of the pinned newer corpus contents.
sources.title: PhreshPhish paper v1, sections 2.2, 3.3, 4.1

sources.decision_support: Version 1.0.1 adds 2025 data and downsampling, unlike the original paper period. Use verified shards, not published aggregate totals; card test total differs from its class-count sum.
sources.title: Pinned PhreshPhish dataset card

sources.decision_support: Keep model choices and learned preprocessing out of test. Fit transformations only on training data; validation drives development.
sources.title: scikit-learn official documentation, section 12.2

sources.decision_support: Independent malware-domain evidence that spatial and temporal evaluation biases inflate results. Transfer the evaluation principle; do not claim its numerical results establish phishing thresholds.
sources.title: TESSERACT, USENIX Security 2019
